City of Encinitas
City Council - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, AUGUST 19, 2015 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Live Well San Diego Award presentation
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the 7/8/15 Regular Meeting, 7/8/15 Special Joint SDWD Meeting, 7/8/15 Special Joint Planning Meeting and the 7/15/15 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2015-08-19 Item 8A - Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants.
2015-08-19 Item 8B - Warrants
8C.
Amendment to the City of Encinitas Legislative Program for 2015. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst McSeveney
Approve the 2015 City of Encinitas Legislative Program as amended.
2015-08-19 Item 8C - 2015 Legislative Program Priorities Revision
8D.
Legislative Position Letters. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst McSeveney
Approve the legislative position letters for the Mayor's signature.
2015-08-19 Item 8D - Legislative Position Letters
8E.
Acceptance of an Assistance to Firefighters Grant Award for a new air compressor system. Contact Person: Fire Chief Daigle
Authorize the acceptance of $50,013 in grant funding from the United States Department of Homeland Security Fiscal Year 2014 Assistance to Firefighters Grant.
2015-08-19 Item 8E - AFG Award Acceptance Agenda Report
8F.
Contract with County of San Diego Probation Department to provide maintenance services. Contact Person: Public Works Deputy Director Hosford
Authorize the City Manager, or his designee, to continue the contract with the County of San Diego Probation Department in the amount not to exceed $272,844.
2015-08-19 Item 8F - Probation Crew Contract
8G.
Amend lease agreement with T-Mobile West Tower LLC. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Stauffer
1) Approve amendment #1 to the lease agreement between the City of Encinitas and T-Mobile West Tower LLC for cellular communication purposes located at 1661 Lake Drive (Cardiff Sports Park), 2) Authorize the City Manager to execute amendment #1 of the lease agreement between the City of Encinitas and T-Mobile West Tower LLC, and 3) Approve the dedication of $162,000 in revenue for park improvement projects.
2015-08-19 Item 8G - T Mobile Lease Renewal
8H.
The Alternative Fuels Feasibility Study for City Fleet Project. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Wilson
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2015-42, Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas amending the Fiscal Year 2015-16 Budget, authorizing an additional appropriation of $31,925, and allowing the Public Works Director to enter into an agreement with Mercury Associates to complete study.
2015-08-19 Item 8H - Alternative Fuel Fleet Study
8I.
Appointment to the Commission for the Arts to fill an unscheduled vacancy with a term ending March 2018. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
The Mayor, with approval from the City Council, appoint Jacqueline "Jax" Meyers to the Commission for the Arts to fill an unscheduled vacancy with a term ending March 2018.
2015-08-19 Item 8I - Arts Commission Appointment
8J.
Adoption of Ordinance 2015-13 adding Chapter 23.13 - SMALL RESIDENTIAL ROOFTOP SOLAR SYSTEMS, establishing an expedited, streamlined permitting process for Small Residential Rooftop Solar Systems, to the Encinitas Municipal Code as required by California Assembly Bill No. 2188. Contact Person: Senior Planner Kusiak
Adopt Ordinance No. 2015-13, entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California adding Chapter 23.13 to the Encinitas Municipal Code to Provide an Expedited, Streamlined Permitting Process for Small Residential Rooftop Solar Systems."
2015-08-19 Item 8J - Residential Rooftop Solar Systems
8K.
Adoption of Ordinance 2015-11 amending Section 23.12.050 (Plumbing Code) and Section 23.12.080(a) of the Encinitas Municipal Code to promote the installation and use of graywater systems. Contact Person: Senior Planner Kusiak
Adopt Ordinance No. 2015-11, entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California amending Section 23.12.050 (Plumbing Code) and Section 23.12.080(a) of the Encinitas Municipal Code to promote the installation and use of graywater systems."
2015-08-19 Item 8K - Plumbing Code
9.

Contact Person: Finance Director Nash
1) Adopt Resolution 2015-53 updating development fees for Parkland Acquisition-Subdivision, Parkland Acquisition-Non-Subdivision, Park Improvement, Open Space Acquisition and Trail Development; and 2) Adopt Resolution 2015-54 updating development fees for Fire Protection.
2015-08-19 Item 10A - Impact Fee Report
10B.
Public Hearing and consideration of Resolution 2015-50 amending fees for Planning and Zoning Services, Resolution 2015-51 amending fees for Engineering Services, Resolution 2015-52 amending fees for Fire Prevention Services and Resolution 2015-55 Setting Fully Burdened Rates for Development Processing Services. Contact Person: Finance Director Nash
1) Adopt Resolution 2015-50 amending Planning and Zoning development processing fees, effective November 1, 2015; 2) Adopt Resolution 2015-51 amending Engineering development processing fees, effective November 1, 2015; 3) Adopt Resolution 2015-52 amending Fire Prevention development processing fees, effective November 1, 2015; and 4) Adopt Resolution 2015-55 setting Fully Burdened Hourly Rates for development processing services, effective November 1, 2015.
2015-08-19 Item 10B - Development Services Fees Cost Recovery Study - (UPDATED Pages 47, 48, 52, 53, 57)

ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
